setup:
git remote add origin https://gitlab.example.com/org/account-service.git
git checkout -qb feat/not-found-404
sed -i '' 's/writeError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "internal error")/if errors.Is(err, ErrNotFound) {\n\t\t\twriteError(w, http.StatusNotFound, "account not found")\n\t\t\treturn\n\t\t}\n\t\twriteError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "internal error")/' internal/account/handler.go
sed -i '' 's|"encoding/json"|"encoding/json"\n\t"errors"|' internal/account/handler.go
gofmt -w internal/account/handler.go
git -c user.email=eval@neo -c user.name=eval commit -aqm 'fix(account): return 404 when the account is missing'
